eva: quick sync: proposing a "precision compatibility guard" for mixed-bit profiles (fp8/int8/4bit) to avoid silent quality/perf mismatches during rollout. high level: profile shipped with model + runtime lint + routing constraints.

noah: +1. can you outline failure modes we want to catch?

eva: main ones:
- node advertises kernel but layout mismatch (sparse vs dense) -> huge perf regressions
- model packaged with profile that references missing kernel -> exec-time failures
- silent fallbacks that exceed customer quality budget

jen: runtime rules idea: 1) on deploy, lint profile against kernel-registry and package checksum; 2) at serve-time, prefer profile.blob (cbor) else json; 3) on kernel-miss consult profile.fallback_order and calibration table; 4) if estimated_delta > budget -> block fallback and route to compatible dense variant. emit quant.path + quant.quality_status.

marc: for rollout can we do: canary nodes advertise capability in node metadata and routing only sends opt-in deployments? so no surprise for stable customers.

noah: yes, route on header: precision_profile or request.headers.features. sample rule (pseudo):
```
- when: request.headers.precision_profile == "mixed-v1"
  route: pool:mixed_canary
- else: route: pool:stable
```

eva: linter rules: profile must include profile_version, per_shard_layout, preferred_kernels, fallback_order, calibration_table, quality_budget_pct, and sample_seed_policy. block deploy when preferred_kernels not in kernel-registry or checksum mismatch. provide actionable error messages.

jen: telemetry keys for infra to alert on: ["quant.abi","quant.profile_id","quant.advertised_kernels","quant.path","quant.fallback_reason","quant.quality_delta","profile_mismatch_execute_failures"]

marc: tests: small canary harness that runs perf smoke, fidelity delta vs baseline on curated prompt set, and adversarial long prompts. add deterministic sampler for fallback traces: sample_seed_policy deterministic_by=customer_id_hash.

ops-bot: Lint job started for deployment "mixed-compat-canary". status: queued.

eva: one more: packager should be able to infer a starter profile: `redwood-quant pack --infer-profile` which emits profile_json + cbor blob + checksum. devex: SDK shows warning if allow_aggressive_fallbacks not explicitly set.

noah: enforcement nuance: older runtimes should ignore unknown profile keys but must still emit quant.path if they fall back. we should add a metric that counts fallbacks where profile indicated a mismatch so we can track upgrade lag.

eva: ok action items: jen drafts linter rules + proto; marc wires routing predicate and canary pool; noah builds sampling harness; i'll add packager flag. aim for dry-run canary next week. thanks! :rocket:
